name: bob-app
description: Bob's Mac app: the Bob window, menu bar dropdown, hotkey panel, desktop widget and settings.

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir && codesign --force --deep --sign - release/mac-arm64/Bob.app
scripts.dist:share: npm run stage:share && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --config electron-builder.share.yml && codesign --force --deep --sign - release-share/mac-arm64/Bob.app
scripts.dmg:share: npm run dist:share && BOB_RELEASE=release-share BOB_DMG_NAME=Bob-Shared bash scripts/make-dmg.sh

author: Bob
